title: 家里发大水了
setting: Hotpot across town, 9:40 pm. Your roommate is home with your black cat, Meiqiu.

giveup.en: Forget it, you're no help at all!
The water has reached the stairwell.
By the time you get home, downstairs is flooded too. Meiqiu watches it all from the fridge.

steps.narr: You're at hotpot across town when your phone starts buzzing. And buzzing.
steps.zh: 你在外面吃火锅，手机一直在震。

steps.en: There's water all over the flat!

steps.zh: 客厅地上全是水，拖鞋都漂起来了
steps.en: The living-room floor under water. The slippers are floating.

say.en: Calm him down, and ask where the water's coming from.
say.gloss: Don't panic! Where's the water coming from?
say.tip: 别慌 biéhuāng = don't panic. 从哪儿来的 = where's it coming from. 漏水 = leak.

ok.zh: 不知道啊！我刚到家，到处都是水！
ok.en: No idea! I just got home and there's water everywhere!

0.en: Ask him where the water's coming from.

say.en: Tell him to turn the water off first!
say.tip: 先把水关了: 先 = first, 把 puts the water before the verb, 关 = switch off (开 is on).

mistakes.note: 开 is on, 关 is off. (And 开水 is boiling water.)

ok.en: Where's the main valve? I can't find it!

say.en: Tell him: it's under the kitchen sink.
say.tip: 在……下面 = under … . 水池 = the sink (水槽 too). 底下 means the same as 下面.

steps.zh: 煤球蹲在冰箱顶上，一脸无辜
steps.en: Meiqiu, crouched on top of the fridge, looking innocent.

steps.zh: 它在上面死活不肯下来
steps.en: It's up there and it will NOT come down.

say.en: Tell him to leave the cat: it'll come down by itself.
answers: 别管它，它自己会下来的。
先别管猫了，它会自己下来的。
不用管它，它自己会下来。
say.gloss: Leave it. It'll come down by itself.
say.tip: 别管它 = leave it be. 自己会……的 = will … on its own (the 的 makes it a reassurance).

alts.en: Tell him to tempt it down with a cat treat
answers: 给它个猫条，它就下来了。
alts.gloss: Tempt it down with a cat treat.

then.zh: 下来了！直接跳进水里了！
then.en: It's down! Jumped straight into the water!

fail.zh: 那它要是一直不下来呢？
fail.en: And what if it never comes down?

steps.zh: 完了，楼下阿姨来敲门了
steps.en: Oh no. The lady from downstairs is at the door.

say.en: Tell him you're getting a taxi home right now.
say.gloss: I'm getting a taxi home right now!
say.tip: 打车 = take a taxi (or a ride-hail). 回去 = go back, from where you are; 回来, from his side, is fine too.

fail.en: Are you coming home or not?

steps.zh: 监控里，煤球用爪子把水龙头打开了
steps.en: Pet-cam footage: Meiqiu turning the tap on with one paw.
You get home to a soaked flat, a fruit basket to buy for downstairs, and Meiqiu asleep on the only dry spot: the fridge.
steps.zh: 煤球趴在冰箱顶上，睡得正香。
